title: Network TimeSample erases origin provenance and rejects valid stratum-4 DIO
description: TimeSample.from_verified_network forces source_class=NETWORK, while _sample_rejection_reason requires stratum 4 to retain GNSS or Local-client provenance. Consequently every authenticated GNSS/gpsd DIO is rejected as source-class-does-not-match-stratum, and the compact option has no way to prove the claimed origin. Define verifier/root-authorized immutable origin evidence separate from transport class, preserve GNSS vs local-client provenance across DIO, and test authorized stratum 1-4 plus forged origin claims.
